listing.name: Bomberman Generation — bomberman-generation-moderngekko (nikeymikey)
listing.summary: Upstream calls it playable with controller support, widescreen, save states, netplay and a Battle bomb-count mod. No full-story completion result is established here. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own USA GBGE5G disc dump. Original assets and local generated game module are required; upstream explicitly does not distribute that module.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Source only by upstream policy: build with CMake, Ninja and MinGW-w64 GCC following docs/building.md; launcher compiles the game module locally on first run. Upstream deliberately publishes no downloadable binaries. Build-Release.ps1 assembles a personal build, not a public release.

warnings: Upstream calls it playable with controller support, widescreen, save states, netplay and a Battle bomb-count mod. No full-story completion result is established here.
